PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_WindowCommon
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all IfcWindow.

PropertyDef.Name: Reference
PropertyDef.Definition: User defined reference for this window type in this project (e.g. type "W-1")

PropertyDef.Name: Description
PropertyDef.Definition: Specific description for this type of window within this project.

PropertyDef.Name: IsExterior
PropertyDef.Definition: Window is an exterior window (TRUE) or interior window (FALSE)

PropertyDef.Name: Infiltration
PropertyDef.Definition: Infiltration flowrate of outside air for the filler object based on the area of the filler object at a pressure level of 50 Pascals. It shall be used, if the length of all joints in unknown. The usual unit (if pressure is taken into consideration) is m3/(hPa2/3). The following translations apply: G: Fugendurchlassigkeit

PropertyDef.Name: ThermalTransmittanceCoefficient
PropertyDef.Definition: Overall thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of the composite materials used by the filler object. It includes internal and external surface coefficient. The usual unit is W/m2K. The following translations apply: G: Gesamtwarmedurchgangskoeffizient

PropertyDef.Name: FireRating
PropertyDef.Definition: Fire rating of complete window assembly. Given according to the national fire safety classification.

PropertyDef.Name: AcousticRating
PropertyDef.Definition: Rating for acoustic transmisivity (Sound Transference Factor =STF) for the complete window assembly.

PropertyDef.Name: SecurityRating
PropertyDef.Definition: ndex based rating system indicating security level.
